title: Fix contract
description: Output of the bounded fix loop. Every round, what it tried, and how it failed. The loop reports; it never spins. A contract that fails this schema is a hard stop, not a warning. The next stage never runs on it.

run_id.description: The run folder under .hyperpower/runs/. null when the stage ran without a run journal.

prompt_hash.description: sha256 of the prompt that produced this contract. The orchestrator stamps it, so it is absent on the contract a stage hands to hp-validate. /hyperpower:resume reads it.

cache_key.description: Stamped by hp-journal after validation. hp-journal owns this shape, so the schema records that the field is legal and checks nothing inside it.

recorded_at.description: Stamped by hp-journal when it writes the step file, so it is absent on the contract a stage hands to hp-validate.

files_read.description: Every path this stage read. /hyperpower:resume re-hashes this list to detect drift. A file read and left out is drift the resume check cannot see.

assumptions.description: Every fact this stage relied on that it did not read in front of it. Present even when empty: an absent array reads to /hyperpower:why as zero assumptions declared. Carry an upstream assumption forward with its original id, claim and declared_at.

id.description: Unique within the run, not within the step. a1, a2.

claim.description: The fact relied on, in one sentence.

declared_at.description: The step that first declared it.

checkable.description: The file path or command that settles the claim later. null when nothing settles it, which stamps the status unresolved.

status.description: declared until the gate-time pass re-reads checkable and stamps it.

rejected.description: Options considered and dropped. /hyperpower:why --rejected reads this array by name, so it is flat and top level.

notes.description: Anything the next stage needs. Never shaped and never capped.

status.description: blocked when the last round failed. That is a hard stop.

rounds.description: One fix.json per run, not one per round. Rounds live here, capped at limits.fix_loop_max_rounds.

builder.description: same for a resumed builder, fresh for one holding only prior_attempts.

model.description: The model that actually ran, not the tier that was asked for.

targets.description: Finding ids or gate names this round attacked.

failure.description: How it failed. null on a pass.

findings_fixed.description: Finding ids the loop cleared. Present even when empty.

findings_open.description: Finding ids still open when the loop stopped. Reported by Render, never dropped. Present even when empty.

max_rounds.description: The ceiling this loop ran under, from limits.fix_loop_max_rounds. Recorded so a reader can tell a loop that stopped from one that was cut short.
